questions.prompt: What is tomorrow’s talk at the Nature Society about?

cueReview.notes: First occurrence verified. ASR rendered 'in parks' as 'impacts'; the repeat matches more literally, but this earlier occurrence is the same publisher line.

questions.prompt: Mickey recommends that people who want to work as hairdressers

cueReview.startQuote: a lot of people make the mistake of thinking they’ve learned all there is to learn
